Recurring Date Calculator

Generate a series of recurring dates: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly from any start date. Perfect for billing cycles, reminders and schedules.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the start date of the series.
  2. Choose the frequency: daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly or every N days.
  3. Set how many occurrences to list (1–60).
  4. Copy the schedule from the dated table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What happens with month-end dates?

They are clamped to the last valid day of each target month: starting Jan 31, the monthly series gives Feb 28 (Feb 29 in leap years), Mar 31, Apr 30, …

How many dates can it generate?

Between 1 and 60 occurrences — enough for a 5-year monthly plan or two months of daily reminders.

Does it handle leap years?

Yes. A yearly series starting Feb 29, 2024 gives Feb 28 in non-leap years and Feb 29 again in 2028.
